title: calochortus invenustus var. montanus
intro: Calochortus invenustus var. montanus, commonly known as the Sierra Mariposa lily, is a rare and endemic plant species found in the Sierra Nevada mountains of California. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Calochortus invenustus var. montanus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, wounds, and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antiseptic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
